policy: Anything govulncheck reaches outside the standard library fails the build. Standard library findings are accepted only under a written acceptance below, and every acceptance carries a date after which the build fails again.

acceptances.reason: The toolchain is pinned to go1.23.5 so that a build in 2027 produces the same binary as a build today. Every standard library advisory govulncheck reports against this program is fixed in a later 1.23 patch, and taking those patches means moving the pin. That is a deliberate trade and it is written down here rather than left to whoever next reads a red pipeline.
checked: The program opens no network listeners it does not own: the only server is the read side service, bound by default to the loopback address.
It parses no untrusted archive, image or certificate. Its inputs are csv exports and its own json.
It runs no template over caller supplied data and executes no subprocess.
The database is sqlite through a pure Go driver, so nothing here links a C library.
